request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-19T18:00:00+02:00:
Er is lekkage geweest in de woonkamer, de muren en de vloer zijn beschadigd. Hierbij een foto. Ik wil graag dat de vloer en de muren worden vergoed.

[EV-0004] sent 2026-10-20T12:58:57.944785+00:00:
Het was gisteren. Een slang van de wasmachine was los, die zit weer vast. De vloer is ongeveer 10 jaar oud.

Repair estimate lines:
- FLOOR-WOOD-REPL: Vloer woonkamer (age on estimate: not stated)
- WALL-PAINT: Muren schilderen (age on estimate: not stated)

what_happened.quote: Er is lekkage geweest in de woonkamer, de muren en de vloer zijn beschadigd.

source.quote: Een slang van de wasmachine was los

affected_items.label: walls
affected_items.quote: de muren en de vloer zijn beschadigd

affected_items.label: floor
affected_items.quote: de muren en de vloer zijn beschadigd

parsed_output.reasoning: EV-0004 sent 2026-10-20 UTC, so 'gisteren' resolves to 2026-10-19. The hose being 'weer vast' is taken as the source being stopped. The floor age is approximate (about 10 years). No wall age was given.
parsed_output.summary: Customer reports a washing machine hose leak yesterday that damaged the living room floor and walls; the hose is re-attached and the floor is about 10 years old.
